findings.reason: Confirmed: runSplitQuery now runs applyTemplateVariables with request.filters. Sub-requests keep `filters` (`{...request, targets}`), and DataSourceWithBackend.query runs applyTemplateVariables again. addFilterAsLabelFilter appends ` | key=`v`` every time with no dedup, so on queries with a parser the ad-hoc label filters get duplicated (three times on the shard path). Query results stay the same, so this is a real but minor defect.

Correct: applyTemplateVariables strips __auto from scopedVars, so in production `$__auto` reaches the backend unchanged, while the mocked `replace` rewrites it anyway. This makes the test misleading but it is still valid, so it is a marginal test-quality point.
